# Execute path one action at a time
# Current position: (2, 0)
# Target: (0, 12)
# Path: RIGHT, RIGHT, RIGHT, RIGHT, RIGHT, RIGHT, UP

path = ['RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'UP']

</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
